From :  The FIA Formula 1 Technical Delegate  
To :  The Stewards Date :  25 July 2026 
  
 
TECHNICAL DELEGATE’S REPORT 
 
 
The following driver is using a new power unit ancillary component (PU-ANC) for the remainder 
of the Competition: 
 
Number Car Driver Previously used PU-ANC 
    
41 Racing Bulls RB Ford Arvid Lindblad 3 
 
The power unit ancillary component used by Arvid Lindblad is one (1) of the six (6) new power 
unit ancillary components allowed for the 2026 Championship season and this is in conformity 
with B8.2.2 g) of the 2026 Formula One Sporting Regulations.
